{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to start fresh
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Apply contract: treatment group AND complete observed data (no -999.0)
df_filtered = df[(df['arm'] == 'treatment') & 
                  (df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0) & 
                  (df['biomarker_baseline'].notnull()) & 
                  (df['biomarker_final'].notnull())]

# Verify no -999.0 remains
assert (df_filtered['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum() == 0, "-999.0 still present in filtered data"

# Check sex distribution
print('Sex distribution in filtered population:')
print(df_filtered['sex'].value_counts())

# Compute mean change in biomarker
df_filtered['biomarker_change'] = df_filtered['biomarker_final'] - df_filtered['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute mean change by sex
mean_change_by_sex = df_filtered.groupby('sex')['biomarker_change'].mean()
print('\nMean biomarker change in treatment group by sex:')
print(mean_change_by_sex)

# Compute difference
difference = mean_change_by_sex['F'] - mean_change_by_sex['M']
print(f'\nDifference (female - male): {difference:.3f} ng/mL')"}
